messages:
Rafael: tiniest emergency alert  Kit (kitten) attempted to excavate the fern and the whole pot went full slow-motion tumble. plant cascade. sending pic + boop vid: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T00000-F99999/fern_cascade.jpg :scream_cat: :seedling:

June: oh nooooo the fern avalanche 😭 that soil trajectory was cinematic. is everyone okay? :joy:

Maya: brought a towel and a spatula. also a bag for the cat (to check for dirt boops). :towel: :shovel:

Theo: status update: Kit very pleased with new digging area. Fern less pleased. rescue team en route (me).

Rafael: quick triage  moved fern to sink, patted roots, removed most dirt. Kit insists on supervising with paw on rim. uploaded short cleanup clip.

June: poll time  who gets custody/guardianship of the fern while it recovers? 1) Rafael (repotting pro) 2) Office lounge (shared plant custody) 3) Plant hospital (Maya's apartment for 48 hrs)

Maya: `/:three:` plant hospital please, I'll give it specialized TLC (and no digging allowed).

Theo: `/:two:` team custody — we can build a tiny fence. :construction:

Rafael: `/:one:` I'm down to repot and rehab. also will craft a tiny "Do Not Dig" sign.

PollBot: Poll created: "Fern custody after cascade" Options: Rafael / Office lounge / Plant hospital  Current votes: Rafael 1, Office lounge 1, Plant hospital 1

June: Kit has discovered the bag of catnip and is now composing a victory newspaper. front page headline: "Fern Strikes Back" :newspaper:

Maya: care notes added to thread: `repot in fresh soil, mist daily, keep out of direct draft, optional rooting hormone` — will bring a spare terracotta pot tomorrow.

Theo: suggestion: add a tiny hammock for Kit so he has a dedicated lounging spot and leaves the plants alone. funding proposals accepted. :money_with_wings:

Rafael: thanks team for the fast rescue. will post replanting pics tomorrow. Kit has been issued a stern look and two treats. :treat: :relieved:
